Allahabad University PGAT Admission 2026 Admit Card - Complete Details

Allahabad University PGAT Admission 2026 Admit Card. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 28/05/2026 (Extended). Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

How to Download Admit Card

  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
